title: Public Transport Network Improvements with Development of Punggol Digital District
what_it_is: Public Transport Network Improvements with Development of Punggol Digital District

sections.label: PDD transport connectivity plans
sections.summary: A new MRT station, bus and road enhancements, walkways, cycling paths and autonomous buses and shuttles are planned for PDD.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: A new Mass Rapid Transit (MRT) station on the North-East Line will open in 2023, when the first phase of PDD developments is ready for occupation.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Enhancements will also be made to the bus network.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: To cater to increased vehicular traffic, we are expanding the Tampines Expressway (TPE) and Kallang-Paya Lebar Expressway (KPE) road interchange linking to Punggol and Pasir Ris and building a new Tampines Expressway (TPE) and Seletar Link interchange.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: There will also be covered walkways and cycling paths in the area to encourage active mobility.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: We are also working towards the deployment of autonomous buses and autonomous on-demand shuttles in PDD from 2022 which will improve first-mile-last mile connectivity for those living or working there.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: These provisions will enhance the connectivity of PDD significantly in the lead up to 2030, when the Cross Island Line in the Punggol region is expected to be ready.

sections.label: Figures for Ms Sun Xueling
sections.summary: The speaker does not have the figures now but will reply to Ms Sun Xueling separately with the exact figures.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: Like I have mentioned, I do not have the figures right now, but I will be happy to reply to Ms Sun Xueling separately with regards to the exact figures.

sections.label: Phased autonomous vehicle deployment
sections.summary: Autonomous vehicle deployment will be phased, confined to PDD for first-mile and last-mile connectivity, and may later extend to other parts of Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: The deployment of autonomous vehicles will be done in phases.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: We do understand the concerns on the ground with regards to displacement of bus captains as well as taxi drivers, for the project in PDD is going to be confined to within the district where it will provide the last-mile and the first-mile connectivity.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: Eventually, in years to come, it may extend to other parts of Singapore as well.
